set.body:
Follow-ups from the cold review of port slice 3 (f1ce778cf). None blocking after 9599e48f6.
- F3: mirror the harness's crash classes as a typed refusal (fence without newline, array reply, non-list units); accept falsy units as an empty chunk.
- F4: json.loads accepts NaN/Infinity; jawn does not. Decide and test.
- F5: unitKey refuses booleans, underscore digits, huge values (fail-closed); document.
- F7: receipt should carry recording key hexes and per-exchange reported model; modelCalls is a literal.
- F8: import maps cache_read with toOption (malformed -> None silently); cache_creation tokens dropped; durationMillis implies false precision.
- F9: import uses REPLACE_EXISTING; refuse differing content, skip identical.
- F10: plan's key had a budget; record that a budgeted record command needs a v2 key domain.
- F11: library chunk<=0 throws; partial output dir on IO error after createDirectories.
- Tests: BadUnitKey path, UNICODE_CHARACTER_CLASS, harnessStrip in parseReply/unitKey, array fallback after object failure, import all-or-nothing, optional fields, non-json filter, AgentPackets and CLI refusals (dev/untouched overlap, missing table).
- Pre-existing (rule 8): ModelReply/ReplyEvidence.Captured and Recordings.write are public, so captured evidence is forgeable by any caller.
set.title: Slice 3 review follow-ups (replay fidelity edges, receipt, import policy)
